name: speckit-lean
description: Cut Spec Kit token cost: tiered agents, phase-sized runs, context and wait guards, and a usage report.

coordinator_ceiling.title: Coordinator context ceiling (tokens)
coordinator_ceiling.description: Warn the main session when its context passes this size. Default 120000.

subagent_ceiling.title: Subagent context ceiling (tokens)
subagent_ceiling.description: Tell a subagent to checkpoint and end when its context passes this size. Default 150000.

wait_guard.title: Wait guard
wait_guard.description: deny: block polling loops (until/while with sleep) in subagents. off: do not block.
